REGULATION 1 OF 1979
TRADE ORGANIZATIONS
ORDINANCE, 1961 (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
A Regulation to apply the
Trade Organisations Ordinance, 1961 (XLV of 1961), to the Tribal Areas
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 5th March, 1979]
No. F. 1(11)-F. III/78.-The following Regulation made
by the President is hereby published for general information :-
Whereas it is expedient to apply the Trade
Organisations Ordinance, 1961 (XLV of 1961), to the Tribal Areas ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of the Proclamation of
the fifth day of July, 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order,
1977 (C.M.L.A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him
in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Regulation :-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This
Regulation may be called the Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961 (Application
to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at once in the
Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan and shall be deemed to
have come into force in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas and the
Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province on
the 31st March, 1977, and the twentieth day of April, 1977, respectively.
2. Application of the Trade Organisations Ordinance,
1961 (XLV of 1961) to the Tribal Areas. The provisions of the Trade Organizations Ordinance,
1961 (XLV of 1961), shall apply to the whole of the Tribal Areas.
